751-3755-6791.description:
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {U}.
When Shrieking Drake enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Shrieking Drake by tapping it, adding {U}.
Resolve the Shrieking Drake ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1263-4871-5670-6794.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 2 or higher.
1263-4871-5670-6794.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion.
When Bloodsoaked Champion dies, Susurian Voidborn and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Susurian Voidborn trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

141-728-5100.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
141-728-5100.description:
Cast Return Upon the Tide by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Return Upon the Tide.
Holding priority, activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Naru Meha, putting a +1/+1 counter on Grimgrin and untapping it.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Return Upon the Tide
Resolve the Return Upon the Tide copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

2486-4050-4694-7306.notablePrerequisites:
You control your commander.
You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
2486-4050-4694-7306.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it, adding one mana of any color.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Master Chef.
Repeat from step 1.

2178-3899-6773.easyPrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard
2178-3899-6773.description:
Activate Xu-Ifit by tapping it, returning a creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing the creature returned in step 1.
When the creature dies, Xu-Ifit triggers, untapping itself.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

7-586-5258-5618-6495.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Evereth ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying at most {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.
7-586-5258-5618-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

5078-6595-6666.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} due to Lyse Hext.
Lyse Hext's prowess ability triggers, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Rook Turret triggers.
Holding priority, activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Resolve the Rook Turret trigger, causing you to draw Sensei's Divining Top from your library, and then discard a card other than Sensei's Divining Top.
Repeat

301-5508-7859.description:
Activate Goblin Chirurgeon by sacrificing Putrid Goblin
When Putrid Goblin dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Putrid Goblin enters, Railway Brawler triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Putrid Goblin.
Resolve the Goblin Chirurgeon ability.
Repeat.

4009-4574-4659-5283-6842.notablePrerequisites:
There must be at least one +1/+1 counter each on Arcbound Reclaimer and at least two additional artifacts.
You control at least three artifacts.
4009-4574-4659-5283-6842.description:
Cast Mox Opal by paying its mana cost.
When you cast that spell, Inexorable Tide triggers, putting one +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Reclaimer and at least two additional artifacts you control.
Activate Mox Opal by tapping it, adding mana.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Mox Opal, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Mox Opal from your graveyard on top of your library.
Activate Iron Spider's last ability by paying {2} and removing two +1/+1 counters from artifacts you control, drawing Mox Opal.
Repeat.

813-4872-7370.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying its mana cost.
Kykar triggers, exiling Scholar of the Ages.
Resolve Time Warp, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Kykar triggers, returning Scholar of the Ages from exile to the battlefield.
When Scholar of the Ages enters, it triggers, returning Time Warp from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

1619-2292-4605-5542-6135.notablePrerequisites: You are able to complete a dungeon.
1619-2292-4605-5542-6135.description:
Complete a dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Aarakocra Sneak from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Aarakocra Sneak enters, it and Preston trigger twice due to Delney.
Holding priority, activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Aarakocra Sneak.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Aarakocra Sneak that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Aarakocra Sneak token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the Aarakocra Sneak token triggers, venturing into Undercity twice.
Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of Aarakocra Sneak that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.
Resolve the first Aarakocra Sneak trigger from step 5, venturing into Undercity and completing Undercity.
Repeat from step 2.
1619-2292-4605-5542-6135.notes: You can choose whatever path you desire while venturing through Undercity.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

6798-6972-7724.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Wakandan Royal Guard.
When Wakandan Royal Guard dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Wakandan Royal Guard enters, it triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

1170-4708-5006.easyPrerequisites: You have not cast a spell using Lurrus this turn.
1170-4708-5006.description:
Cast Dark Sphere from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Lurrus.
Activate Dark Sphere by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and without a -1/-1 counter on it

3099-3129-4762-5902.description:
Activate Leyline of Abundance by paying {6}{G}{G}, putting four +1/+1 counters on each creature you control due to Primal Vigor and Innkeeper's Talent.
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping Devoted Druid.
Repeat from step 2 three additional times.
Repeat from step 1.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

955-1308-1563-3899.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

1308-1409-6463.description:
Activate Meticulous Artisan by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Meticulous Artisan enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Meticulous Artisan.
Resolve the Meticulous Artisan trigger, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

1661-2464-3459-5078.notablePrerequisites: Song of Freyalise's first or second chapter ability has triggered this turn.
1661-2464-3459-5078.description:
Activate Battered Golem by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Battered Golem triggers, untapping Battered Golem.
Repeat.

339-677-3967-7060.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

4050-6435-6977.easyPrerequisites: There are four or more permanent cards in your graveyard exclding Coati Scavenger.
4050-6435-6977.description:
Cast Emptiness for its evoke cost by paying {W}{W}.
When Emptiness enters, its first ability and evoke ability trigger.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Emptiness, adding {W}.
Resolve Emptiness's evoke trigger, failing to sacrifice it as it's no longer on the battlefield.
Resolve Emptiness's first trigger, returning Coati Scavenger from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Coati Scavenger enters, it triggers, returning Emptiness from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Coati Scavenger, adding {W}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and is level 2 or higher

1318-4730-5352.easyPrerequisites: You control a mana-producing permanent that enters the battlefield untapped and that can tap to produce at least {U}.
1318-4730-5352.description:
Cast Doppelgang by paying {6}{G}{U}, targeting Sparring Mummy and a mana-producing permanent.
Holding priority, activate Echo Mage by paying {U}{U} and tapping it, copying Doppelgang, targeting Sparring Mummy and a mana-producing permanent.
Resolve the copy of Doppelgang, creating two copies of Sparring Mummy and the mana-producing permanent.
When the Sparring Mummy tokens enter, they trigger, untapping Echo Mage and any other applicable permanent.
Holding priority, activate the two mana-producing permanent tokens by tapping them, adding at least {U}{U}.
Repeat from step 2.
1318-4730-5352.notes: If desired, you may only resolve one trigger in step 4. This would allow the next iteration to target any other permanent instead of Sparring Mummy. You can then use the second trigger to untap Echo Mage again and proceed.

3470-5702--131.manaNeeded: {2}{G} plus enough mana to animate the land
3470-5702--131.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
3470-5702--131.description:
Animate the land.
Cast Springheart Nantuko for its bestow cost by paying {1}{G}, attaching it to the animated land.
Play any land.
When the land enters the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko and Lotus Cobra trigger.
Resolve the Lotus Cobra trigger, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of the land it is attached to.
When the land token enters the battlefield, Lotus Cobra and Springheart Nantuko trigger.
Holding priority, activate the land token by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Repeat from step 5.

500-1181-1809.description:
Cast Saw in Half by paying {2}{B}, destroying Returned Pastcaller and creating two token copies of it with base power equal to half the destroyed creature's power and base toughness equal to half the destroyed creature's toughness, rounding up each time.
When the Returned Pastcaller tokens enter the battlefield, they trigger, returning Saw in Half and Sacrifice from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Sacrifice by paying {B} and sacrificing a Returned Pastcaller token, adding an amount of {B} equal to its mana value. 
Repeat.

2403-5670-6792--5.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 2 or higher.
2403-5670-6792--5.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability and Moonlit Wake trigger.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning the persist creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Moonlit Wake trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
When the Treasure enters, Mm'menon triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature.
Repeat.

2131-2541-4451.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on Benthic Biomancer.
Benthic Biomancer triggers, causing you to mill three cards and return Greater Mossdog from your graveyard to your hand, and then causing you to discard Greater Mossdog.
Thran Vigil triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Benthic Biomancer.
Repeat from step 2.

2793-3129-3743-4067-5089.manaNeeded: {5} available, with an additional {5} every fourth turn
2793-3129-3743-4067-5089.description:
Activate Osgir by paying {5}, tapping it and exiling Ugin's Nexus from your graveyard, creating four token copies of Ugin's Nexus.
Put three of the Ugin's Nexus tokens into exile due to the legend rule and their replacement effects, causing you to take three extra turns after this one.
Activate Karn's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, choosing to do nothing.
Move to your next extra turn.
Repeat from step 3 one additional time.
Activate Karn's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, returning Ugin's Nexus from exile to your hand.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding Ugin's Nexus.
Move to your last extra turn.
Repeat.

4112-5400.description:
Cast Synth Infiltrator by paying {3}{U}{U}, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Sharuum the Hegemon.
Put Synth Infiltrator into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Synth Infiltrator's enters-the-battlefield ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Sharuum the Hegemon.
Repeat from step 2.

1283-4050-4078-4242-5070.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 4.
1283-4050-4078-4242-5070.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Su-Chi, adding one mana of any color.
When Su-Chi dies, it triggers, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate Chainer by paying {3} and 3 life, returning Su-Chi to the battlefield from your graveyard.
When Su-Chi enters the battlefield, Angelic Chorus triggers, causing you to gain life equal to Su-Chi's toughness.
Repeat.

2825-3263-3525-4923.notablePrerequisites:
Pemmin's Aura attached to Elite Arcanist.
Elite Arcanist does not have summoning sickness.
2825-3263-3525-4923.description:
Activate Elite Arcanist's ability by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Cabal Ritual without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Cabal Ritual, adding at least {3}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {1}, untapping Elite Arcanist.
Repeat.
If you have seven or more cards in your graveyard, this combo nets infinite mana.

1636-2366-3346-4875-5220.notablePrerequisites:
Bog Glider does not have summoning sickness.
"Mercenary" chosen with Conspiracy.
1636-2366-3346-4875-5220.description:
Activate Bog Glider by tapping it and sacrificing Dryad Arbor.
When Dryad Arbor dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Dryad Arbor on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Bog Glider ability, searching your library for Dryad Arbor and putting it onto the battlefield.
When Dryad Arbor enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

1885-2639-4050-4823.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing Mitotic Slime and Timeless Witness, adding {W}{W}.
When Mitotic Slime dies, it triggers, creating two 2/2 Ooze creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Oozes, adding {G}{G}.
When the Oozes die, they trigger, creating four 1/1 Ooze creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar three times by sacrificing three Oozes, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Cast Eerie Ultimatum by paying {W}{W}{B}{B}{B}{G}{G}, returning Timeless Witness and Mitotic Slime to the battlefield from your graveyard.
When Timeless Witness enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Eerie Ultimatum from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2645-3068-3430.notablePrerequisites: Jenson does not have summoning sickness.
2645-3068-3430.description:
Activate Jenson by paying {5} and tapping it, adding three mana of each color.
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Jenson.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

1766-2816-3088.notablePrerequisites: Thran Dynamo and Xenic Poltergeist does not have summoning sickness.
1766-2816-3088.description:
Activate Xenic Poltergeist by tapping it, targeting Thran Dynamo.
Activate Umbral Mantle's equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to the Thran Dynamo.
Activate Thran Dynamo by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Umbral Mantle by paying {3} and untapping it, giving itself +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.

656-2034-2399-4809.notablePrerequisites: At least one +1/+1 counter on Shifting Wall.
656-2034-2399-4809.description:
Sacrifice Shifting Wall to Ashnod's Altar for {C}{C}.
Colfenor triggers, returning Ugin's Conjurant from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Ugin's Conjurant for {1}.
Sacrifice Ugin's Conjurant to Ashnod's Altar for {C}{C}.
Colfenor triggers, returning Shifting Wall from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Shifting Wall for {1}.
Repeat.

954-2302-4050-4215.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Angel of Fury, adding one mana of any color.
Angel of Fury and Verdant Succession trigger.
Resolve the Angel of Fury trigger, shuffling it into your library.
Resolve the Verdant Succession trigger, searching your library for Angel of Fury, putting it onto the battlefield and shuffling your library.
Repeat.
